svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif
svg.title: WordPilot high-level system architecture
svg.desc: WordPilot architecture: FastAPI plans documents and enforces human approval, then invokes compiled LangGraph for deterministic DOCX editing, integrity verification, and gated output delivery. Ollama or Groq is used only for planning.
svg.text: Plan → human approval → deterministic DOCX edit → integrity verification. The LLM only proposes operations; it never edits the document.
No edit before approval · reject creates no output
proposes only: no tools, no file path
separate path; not called by API
ops in order · stop on failure
all other ZIP parts copied as-is
integrity report + output return to the API
integrity report + output return to the API
